subject: STABLE api-surface-sonnet #5: IOSurface options, parentRelative*, TEGU_UNRECOGNIZED field inventory hook
body: api_surface_frontend_test ASan+UBSan PASS (2500-iteration misuse fuzz, live balance 0 in every group). NOTE: it only builds right now with API_EXTRA_CFLAGS='-include gpu/include/nord2_gpu_transport.h' because of the nord2_transport.inc break reported at 03:28 (still open; the production iOS line of tools/build_tegu_frontend_objects.sh has no -Iinclude, so the fix is an #include "../../include/nord2_gpu_transport.h" at the top of nord2_transport.inc). Added since #4: (1) IOSurface imports (newTextureWithDescriptor:iosurface:plane:) accept CPU-cache/hazard bits like every other texture (render_encoder.inc head hunk, same normalisation); (2) MTLTexture parentRelativeLevel/parentRelativeSlice (two ivars + two assignments in the sub-range view code); (3) field-inventory hook: +resolveInstanceMethod: on every Tegu class LOGS 'TEGU_UNRECOGNIZED class= sel=' (256 lines, repeats suppressed, answers NO exactly like NSObject) so the next device run lists every selector a client sends that we lack; (4) parallel render encoder records plain structs (no block literals). iOS arm64 -Wall -Wextra -Werror compile clean apart from the transport break.
